title: AWS S3 bucket encryption state
description: Per-bucket default-encryption configuration captured by the AWS connector. v1.1 adds kms_key_id (the KMS key as configured on the bucket, which AWS accepts as a key ID, alias or ARN) and reason (why the connector could not decide). The record's result is the verdict; encryption_enabled is true only when default encryption was observed.

encryption_enabled.description: True when a default server-side encryption rule was observed. False both when the bucket has none and when the connector could not read it; result and reason tell those apart.

kms_key_id.description: KMSMasterKeyID exactly as configured: a key ID, alias or ARN.

reason.description: Why the result is inconclusive, e.g. the AWS error from the region or encryption lookup.
